key_insight: SCOPE-RL densifies sparse verifiable rewards by adding pre-success scaffolded prefix rewards and post-success process-shape rewards, improving both reasoning quality and token efficiency.
engineering_relevance: For LLM reasoning systems, it offers a practical RLVR training strategy that can boost accuracy while reducing reasoning cost, making it relevant for efficient deployment.
method: Adaptive Scaffolded RL: assigns prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on hidden sub-question chains before success.
Quality-Aware Process RL: uses correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine already-correct trajectories after success.
Keeps the GRPO update while expanding the reward signal without changing the final-answer verifier.
evidence_signal: On Qwen3-8B-Instruct with DAPO-Math and Big-Math, the method improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 percentage points and cuts reasoning tokens by up to 27.1%, with gains also observed under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct.
watch_item: Because the reward design depends on expert-validated step quality and answer-hidden sub-question structure, it may require careful task-specific annotation or robust decomposition heuristics to generalize well.
paper_title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
